stories.title: Eight pages, crew spanning three of them
stories.recipe: Pages of two or three lines; every employee crosses at least one page break.

stories.title: One seafarer in three vessels, each with its own net
stories.recipe: Three nets for one person in three vessels; the payee account is one person’s and is not listed.

stories.title: An advance recovered in three installments
stories.recipe: Three equal deductions with three line IDs are three deductions.

stories.title: One line ID on two pages with two different amounts
stories.recipe: The second copy of the sea allowance shows 45.000, not 50.000; one line ID cannot be two amounts, and every total foots what was printed.

stories.title: The employer pension printed as a deduction
stories.recipe: Typed as a deduction, the employer’s 84.000 would come out of the seafarer’s pay; the printed net did not take it, so the equation fails.

stories.title: Zero components written as 0 and 0.000
stories.recipe: 0 and 0.000 are both written zeros in rials; both lines stay.

stories.title: Two employees with equal pay, dimensions and payee account
stories.recipe: Everything equal but the employee ID: two employees, and the shared account listed.

stories.title: A page whose currency label is written in lower case
stories.recipe: omr is not OMR as text, so the page is excluded; the run totals counted it, so nothing foots.

stories.title: A page from the October run
stories.recipe: October's page for the same seafarer counts nowhere.

stories.title: A page that loses its end row before the run totals
The run totals printed before the pages
stories.recipe: The block can stand anywhere in the file.

stories.title: Labels in another order, spaces around values and column names
stories.recipe: Ordinary spaces at either end are removed from labels, values and column names.

stories.title: A blank line after every row
stories.recipe: Blank rows are ignored everywhere.

stories.title: Amounts with leading zeros and Persian digits
stories.recipe: 012500.00 and Persian digits are amounts; the point stays a point.

stories.title: A thousands separator in one amount
stories.recipe: 3,250.00 is not read as 3250.00, and without it nothing foots.

stories.title: An employee ID that ends in a no-break space
stories.recipe: Only ordinary spaces are removed; the base pay line is no one’s.

stories.title: A component that begins with a plus sign
stories.recipe: +Bonus could be a formula; the line still foots.

stories.title: A net line whose kind is written Net
One line ID used for two seafarers
stories.recipe: Neither line can be told from the other by its ID.

stories.title: The net paid into another account
An unpaid month: a zero net and nothing else
stories.recipe: Zero earnings minus zero deductions is the zero printed.

stories.title: A page total of the employer pension off by one baisa
A run net total one baisa short
Two section IDs, one reused by an excluded page
stories.recipe: The excluded page shares the ID but is not a second section of this run.

stories.title: Run totals closed under another run
A reviewer note inside the run totals
A scope currency the contract does not list
A component holding a line break
stories.recipe: A line break is a control character in a component; the record still counts as one row.

stories.title: The net line printed before the earnings
An employee ID equal to another's payee account
stories.recipe: The payee column is never read as an employee.

stories.title: Bahraini dinars and Arabic identifiers
240 employees across twelve pages
stories.recipe: Uneven page breaks fall inside employees; three planted faults.
